ESMAP and EASEG (2001). Technology Assessment of Clean Coal Technologies for China, Volume II: Environmental and Energy Efficiency Improvements for Non-Power Uses of Coal. ESMAP and EASEG Technical Paper 011, Joint UNDP/World Bank Energy Sector Management Assistance Programme, Washington DC, May 2001.

Printed page numbers used. Region China, data circa 1997-2000. Loaded: Table 2.2 efficiencies (industrial boilers, kilns, coal per t ammonia); coke ovens Table D.1 (stamping vs conventional 6-m) and D.2 (eight small ovens; per-t coal and electricity derived from printed totals); gasifier Table 6.1 (efficiency, temperature, capex, gas cost) and plant examples Tables 6.3-6.5. No price year is printed: all yuan values marked 2001 with the not-stated flag. Table D.1 energy line is printed "Mtce" per tonne coke, read as tce/t. Table D.1/D.2 text columns are garbled; assignment checked against raw text and the printed per-tonne investment. Table 6.5 investment printed descending (25-15), loaded as 15-25. Gasification efficiency basis not stated. Not loaded: coal preparation, briquetting (other-values only), direct liquefaction, pollutant emissions. No cement-kiln-specific or boiler capex/opex exists in the report; kiln and boiler data are efficiency only.
